descriptions: A Navi dive is a type of cutscene dive achieved byfalling off a ledge while talking to Navi. While the usual method for achieving this is a TSC, it is also possible to perform using a jump attack with deku sticks.
You may be expected to enter BotW with a stick Navi dive.
You may be expected to use the LH to ZD shortcut with a stick Navi dive.
You may be expected to use the LW to ZR shortcut with a stick Navi dive.
label: Navi Dive (Stick)

description: When doing a three-slash-combo with either the Kokiri Sword or the Master Sword and put it away, Link will be placed back a small distance. If, while slashing, you use the recoil of hitting a wall and then put away the sword, Link may clip into a wall behind him if angled correctly.
descriptions: When doing a three-slash-combo with either the Kokiri Sword or the Master Sword and put it away, Link will be placed back a small distance. If, while slashing, you use the recoil of hitting a wall and then put away the sword, Link may clip into a wall behind him if angled correctly.
Basic Triple Slash Clipping may be required.
Some more complex OoB movement may be required.
Very precise OoB movement may be required.
Very precise TSCs may be required.
label: Triple Slash Clip

description: A Ledge Clip allows Link to fall through a floor or pass through an object by facing a wall and dropping down to the left in various ways. These only work as an adult.
descriptions: A Ledge Clip allows Link to fall through a floor or pass through an object by facing a wall and dropping down to the left in various ways. These only work as an adult.
Basic Ledge Clips may be required. Some require that you let go of the ledge with a specific timing.
Certain harder clips may also be required.
Ledge clips with complex OoB movement may be required.
label: Ledge Clip

description: Where 2 walls come together they form a seam that Link can stand on. It is possible to use these to gain height and reach normally inaccessible areas. Additionally these seams can reach far above the walls that form them, creating invisible seams.
descriptions: Where 2 walls come together they form a seam that Link can stand on. It is possible to use these to gain height and reach normally inaccessible areas. Additionally these seams can reach far above the walls that form them, creating invisible seams.
Short seam walks up visible walls with ISG may be required.
Short seam walks up visible walls without ISG or longer seam walks with ISG may be required.
Longer seam walks without ISG may be required.
Very precise seam walks may be required.
Crossing Gerudo Valley as child by walking up a wall with the cucco may be required.
label: Seam Walk
